Package one.x1f.sip.foundation.core.declarative.annotation.connector.extension

Annotation Interface RequestExtension

@Target({METHOD,TYPE}) @Retention(RUNTIME) public @interface RequestExtension
Annotation that is used to mark an extension that should be attached to the request-flow of a Connector.

The annotation can either be placed on a separate class implementing ConnectorExtension, in which case the connector it should be attached to must be provided via value() or connectorId().

Alternatively, the annotation can be placed on a method inside a connector class. Using this approach, no additional attributes need to be specified, and the following usage patterns are possible:

  • The method can take no arguments and return a ConnectorExtension instance
  • The method returns void and has a single parameter of type RouteDefinition.

For ordering of multiple processors, ExecutionOrder can be used for absolute ordering, while ExecuteAfter or ExecuteBefore can be used for relative ordering.
